outcome: Haematological parameters (complete haemogram, nucleated Red Blood Cells, reticulocyte count)
cohort: The study included 40 newborns, equally divided into groups with and without maternal and perinatal risk factors, from whom cord blood samples and APGAR scores were collected.
finding: Low APGAR scores, acidic cord blood pH, and high Neutrophil-Lymphocyte Ratio were associated with the presence of maternal and perinatal risk factors.
